basics.summary: Backend-focused full-stack developer specializing in scalable RESTful APIs, cloud infrastructure, vector search & AI-integrated RAG pipelines, and automated CI/CD. Currently Full Stack Developer Intern at Zytexa Technology LLP. 2× Recommended by SSB for the Indian Air Force.

work.summary: Building the backend of CivilCheck, a three-sided property-verification marketplace with role-isolated authentication and transaction settlement systems.
highlights: Building the backend of CivilCheck, a three-sided property-verification marketplace — 12 Prisma/PostgreSQL models with role-isolated JWT auth (buyer / seller / admin) that makes cross-role token reuse structurally impossible.
Engineering marketplace financial logic, seller earnings & settlement APIs, admin refund workflows, and frozen commission splits at purchase time for audit integrity.

work.summary: Built an internal employee appraisal system, architecting a layered Java backend with Spring Boot to handle multi-step review cycles and complex HR workflows.
highlights: Built an employee appraisal platform end-to-end with a layered Spring Boot backend on MySQL, DTO-isolated API contracts, and global exception handling.
Secured every route with Spring Security 6 + JWT role-based access for HR, manager, and employee actors, consumed by a React.js + TypeScript dashboard.
